indicator_name: Real interest rates (ex ante, ex post) and a monetary conditions index (computed by this repository)
description: Реальные процентные ставки (ex ante, ex post) и индекс денежно-кредитных условий (расчёт репозитория)
methodology: Base rate (BASE_RATE, monthly mean of the daily step function), TONIA (monthly mean), CPI_YOY, household inflation expectations (INFLATION_EXPECTATIONS, median for 12 months ahead, from 2016). Real rate = (1+i)/(1+pi)-1 (Fisher). MCI = (real ex-ante base rate - its 2016+ mean) + 1/3 x 100 ln(REER / its 2016+ mean); the 1/3 weight is the conventional 3:1 rate/exchange-rate ratio, not an estimate for Kazakhstan. A higher MCI is tighter. From 2015-09 (inflation targeting).
